name: Nexchip Semiconductor Corporation
summary: Nexchip Semiconductor Corporation engages in the research, development, production, and sale of integrated circuit-related products in China and internationally. The company offers display driver chips, CMOS image sensors, microcontrollers, power management, and logic applications products for use in consumer electronics, smartphones, smart home appliances, security, industrial control, and automotive electronics. It also provides technical services, including design and manufacturing services. In addition, the company engages in the research and development of electronic special materials, and new materials technologies; design and development; business management; business management, socio-economic, financial, information technology, and information consulting services; and investment activities. Nexchip Semiconductor Corporation was founded in 2015 and is based in Hefei, China.
